newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks jump in early trade on tankan result.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks jump in early trade on tankan result.

text.p: Tokyo stocks jumped in early Wednesday morning trade inspired by the Bank of Japan's "tankan" business survey.
The survey of corporate confidence produced surprisingly strong figures, suggesting that Japan's economy may not be as feeble as had been believed, brokers said.
After 17 minutes of trade, the Nikkei 225 was up 161.72 points or 0.80 percent at 20,503.65. Its September futures were up 210 at 20,580.
The tankan's key diffusion index for major manufacturers was plus seven, up from plus two in March. Economists' forecasts had ranged from minus four to plus four.
